ideas.title: Investigating the Minnesota Daycare Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent developments in the Minnesota daycare fraud case and the potential consequences for the state's daycare system.
questions: What are the potential consequences for the state's daycare system?
How will the investigation proceed without the lead prosecutors?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant corruption and mismanagement in the state's daycare system. By following the money and investigating the recent developments, we may be able to shed light on the motivations behind the fraud and the consequences for the state.
